verdict.rationale: Lambda's docs say every ODC instance ships with a preinstalled JupyterLab server that you open from the Instances page, which delivers the 'open Jupyter in one step' half of the story. SSH access is documented, but there is no first-party one-step VS Code/Cursor connect flow, so IDE access depends on standard SSH setup. Missing for 10: a documented one-click VS Code/Cursor remote connection, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the JupyterLab access flow.
